visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) View from inside a vehicle looking out at a Lexus service reception where a staff member in a black uniform stands holding a tablet. Cut to an outdoor driveway where a woman with long black hair, wearing a white fuzzy cardigan and a black-and-white plaid skirt, walks toward the service center entrance. (2) Inside a mirrored elevator, the woman fixes her bangs while a man in a grey puffer jacket films her with a handheld camera and a small microphone. The reflection shows multiple people in the elevator. (3) The woman is seated in a modern lounge with marble-textured walls and bright lighting. She browses a thick menu book. A server places a glass of water on a black circular table. A variety of food items—pesto pasta, mentaiko bread, a rice ball, and drinks—are displayed. (4) Close-up shots of the woman eating. She takes a bite of the orange-topped mentaiko bread and the salmon-filled rice ball. She points to specific pages in the menu featuring 'weekday limited' sets and Häagen-Dazs ice cream. (5) The woman uses a laptop in the lounge. A quick cut shows a technician in a blue uniform and the man standing beside a silver SUV in the service bay, inspecting the vehicle. (6) The man holds a printed invoice and speaks directly to the camera in the lounge. The woman joins him, holding a blue tablet and gesturing toward the camera while smiling, ending the video in a brightly lit indoor setting.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Upbeat acoustic guitar and light drums create a cheerful pop background. A high-energy female voice introduces the video, followed by a male narrator. Ambient outdoor traffic hum is minimal. (2) Inside an elevator, the female voice is expressive and animated, echoing slightly against the metal walls. Casual conversation between the two main characters continues with clear articulation. (3) The acoustic scene shifts to a quiet indoor lounge. Sound of a menu page turning (rustle). The woman's voice asking a question is prominent over the BGM. A 'ding' SFX plays when food appears. (4) Distinct crunching and chewing sounds (incidental noise) occur as the woman eats. A 'sparkle' SFX emphasizes the visual of the dessert. Her voice hits high pitch peaks during her enthusiastic review. (5) Transition to the service bay; sound of a car being inspected. A new male voice (technician) is heard briefly. The primary male narrator delivers technical info at a steady, professional pace. (6) Final scene in the lounge features a balanced mix of speech and BGM. The male speaker reports the cost with a clear, authoritative tone. The woman finishes with an upbeat question, accompanied by a final high-pitched chime SFX.
